title: Seok et al. 2019, ZnO:Ga-graded ITO electrodes to control interface between PCBM and ITO in planar perovskite solar cells (STAM 20:389)
notes: Seven electrodes: 125 nm ITO monolayer (0), GZO/ITO bilayers with 15 and 20 nm GZO, and GZO-graded ITO G5/G10/G15/G20 (graded region 5-20 nm, total 150 nm). All were RTA-annealed at 600 °C for 10 min.
ITO: DC 100 W, Ar 20 sccm, 3 mTorr, 4-in ITO target, room temperature. GZO: RF, ramped 0→180 W during grading; GZO target composition and bilayer GZO conditions are not stated.
Text values: G15 Rsh 15.6 Ω/sq, ρ 2.3e-4 Ω cm, T 95% @550 nm; ITO monolayer T 92.79%; bilayer T 90.43% (which bilayer unclear). Everything else for the electrodes is Fig. 2 only and not recorded.
The 20 nm GZO single layer (T 96.04%) is optimised only in the SI; recorded as an ambiguous sample. Table 1 FoM values and the 6.7 nm MoO3 / 100 nm Ag / PCBM layers are not fields.
Rotation 30 rpm is stated for bilayer and graded sputtering; for the ITO monolayer it is only implied.
